# Gaps between Chapter 3 Thrown types and the compiler, found by
# FuzzReturnedCallableCalls. Chapter 3: tags attach to call signatures, and
# the signature of a returned callable carries its own; a signature with no
# tag throws unknown, which plain code calls as an ordinary call and effect
# code wraps (EK0403). When make carries a tag and returns an untagged
# callable written inside its own declaration (inline in its return type,
# as the return type of an arrow const, or in the type of a declare const),
# the returned signature takes the tag of make: under @throws {never} effect
# code calls it with no EK0403, and under @throws {Error} or {unknown} plain
# code reports a second EK0401 for the returned call. A returned type written
# as a type alias keeps its own contract. A key is
# untagged-returned/<spelling>/<outer tag>/<host>; each covers the monomorphic
# and generic signatures and the direct, parenthesized and bound call forms.
# target                   key                               owner     what is missing
FuzzReturnedCallableCalls  untagged-returned/arrow-const/Error/arrow  compiler  Chapter 3: make carries @throws {Error} and returns an untagged callable written as the return type of an arrow const; an exported arrow reports a second EK0401 for the returned call, because its signature takes the tag of make instead of staying an ordinary call; lane impl-hunt-fail
FuzzReturnedCallableCalls  untagged-returned/arrow-const/Error/function  compiler  Chapter 3: make carries @throws {Error} and returns an untagged callable written as the return type of an arrow const; a function reports a second EK0401 for the returned call, because its signature takes the tag of make instead of staying an ordinary call; lane impl-hunt-fail
FuzzReturnedCallableCalls  untagged-returned/arrow-const/Error/method  compiler  Chapter 3: make carries @throws {Error} and returns an untagged callable written as the return type of an arrow const; a class method reports a second EK0401 for the returned call, because its signature takes the tag of make instead of staying an ordinary call; lane impl-hunt-fail
